gavinlordofpugs: Henrik Gavinlordofp introduced himself as a lamplighter from Esterhaus. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A sniper's bullet hit Henrik Gavinlordofp at R-F5. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao).
The surgeon worked on Henrik Gavinlordofp until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.
Another member of the House of Gavinlordofp reached the line: Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp. He asked where Henrik Gavinlordofp had slept, then chose a different corner.
Dawn watch. Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Benedikt Calderthebal, grazed.
its.hop_: "You're late," said the corporal when Bram "Bones" Hop arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Bram "Bones" Hop found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home reached Bram "Bones" Hop before dusk. Bram "Bones" Hop read it twice and slept a little easier. Bram "Bones" Hop became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
Bram "Bones" Hop was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers.
le.mrsh_: Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh reached R-F16 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh has learnt to recognise the ration cart by its squeaking wheel. A different squeak caused considerable disappointment this afternoon. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
At Lantern Hill, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
A parcel came for Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh and Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
